name: Kizaki Shinji
source:
Friend and classmate of the protagonist Shinichi. He is an otaku.

[spoiler]He found a porn site where a girl who looks like Yotsuba appears, and asks Shinichi if he knows anything about it or if Yotsuba is acting strange. Near the end, he convinced Shinichi to not jump off the roof just because his beloved has become used goods.[/spoiler]
